title: A planned bug that fixes a code pattern lists the pattern's other sites in the tree, so a sibling is fixed or filed before the start
goal: precheck, or the planning step of /kb-sprint, lists for a committed bug whose goal names a code expression (such as round(0.95 * n) as a p95 rank) the other places the tree holds it, so each is in the goal, filed as its own item or named as out of scope before the start (SP-e4fm2ovk: BG-v5f5tn5y fixed the freshness p95, its worker found the verdict p95 int(0.95 * n) and filed BG-pjtajc2m, the review found bench_core.stat_rows' round() p95 and parked BG-z4mcy4w4)
